notes: The one article in the verse (s005, before Ἀθηνῶν) is unrepresented under rule 23; the ASV writes no determiner for the place name. The earlier review note claiming 'both articles' overcounted: Κόρινθον stands anarthrous.

The clause juncture 'and' before 'came' rides on ἦλθεν as a rule 88 helper, the ASV having converted the participle χωρισθείς into the coordinate finite clause 'he departed'; rule 98's asyndetic-seam case does not reach it because a participle stands.
ταῦτα → 'these things' heads on the demonstrative under rule 17's generic-noun clause.
